text:
noah (eng-runtime): quick heads-up from vuln triage: jemalloc CVE-2026-4101 backport available. proposing a rebuild of base-slim and use our new delegated-signer-proxy to sign artifacts. low exploit scope but want to close fast.

selena (eng-security): ok. two gating items: (A) proof of patch included in SBOM + commit SHAs in attestation predicate, (B) audit trail for signing + proxy requests kept 13 months. Also need RBAC so only the proxy service account can call KMS.

noah (eng-runtime): artifacts are built and sitting in staging: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-slim/4101112222 (unsigned).

priyam (eng-infra): we can provision a temporary CMK alias/proxy-sign-4101-temp. but because we're using delegated-signer-proxy, we'll give the proxy's IAM role kms:Sign and add a tight condition: SourceAccount + SourceVpc + aws:CalledVia = our CI runner. snippet: 

```
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Sign","kms:GetPublicKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/PROXY_4101","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"},"StringLike":{"aws:RequestedVia":"ci-runner*"}}}]}
```

selena (eng-security): good. also require CloudTrail event export for kms:Sign and S3 PutObject to our attest-bucket; retention 13 months and enable logValidation. open ticket for compliance.

zoe (oncall): rollout plan suggestion: quick canary 2% (30m) -> 10% (2h) -> 100% in 24h if green. thresholds: startup-failures >0.5% or OOM spikes -> pause and rollback. who triggers rollback?

noah (eng-runtime): i'll own canary metrics and trigger rollback. zoe you'll coordinate pager escalation. selena you own SIEM alerts. priyam do key + RBAC + proxy IAM.

selena (eng-security): RBAC in k8s: create a RoleBinding so delegated-signer-proxy SA in infra ns can read/write attestation CRs in `attest` ns, and restrict promotion job to ci:promotion-sa. example: 

```
kubectl create rolebinding proxy-attest-access -n attest --role=attest-writer --serviceaccount=infra:delegated-signer-proxy
kubectl create rolebinding ci-promotion-only -n ci --role=promotion-invoker --serviceaccount=ci:promotion-sa
```

priyam (eng-infra): created key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/PROXY_4101. applied IAM policy to proxy role and added condition. enabled CloudTrail data events for ECR & S3; opened INFRA-5102 to extend SIEM retention to 13 months and enable log validation.

attest-webhook-bot: artifact uploaded to staging: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-slim/4101112222 62 unsigned.

noah (eng-runtime): CI changes: wire delegated proxy endpoint instead of direct KMS URI. high level: 

```
- run: curl -X POST https://proxy.internal.signing/sign -d '{"image":"registry/base-slim:4101112222","sbom":"sbom.json","meta":{"git_sha":"$GIT_SHA"}}'
- run: aws s3 cp sbom.json s3://redwood-attestations/base-slim/4101112222/sbom.json
```

selena (eng-security): attestations must include sbom_hash, git_sha, changelog_url, ksm_key_arn, signing_principal (proxy role). proxy must log incoming requester identity and forward that to CloudTrail/S3 as part of the attestation object.

zoe (oncall): starting provisional window at 09:45 PT. i'll watch health dashboards (p95 latency, crashloops, image pull errors). if metrics cross thresholds, i'll pause and call rollback.

noah (eng-runtime): starting 2% canary now once proxy is up. will post metrics in ~12m. keep updates in this thread only.

selena (eng-security): I'll validate attestations & SBOM hash after signing. also tag this release as "high-provenance" for auditors.

priyam (eng-infra): proxy is live and attached to key. IAM + k8s RBAC applied. leaving INFRA ticket with links.
